extracted.name: Chicory & gorgonzola salad
extracted.description: Make this salad for a light snack or a colourful side dish – the gorgonzola gives it a lovely depth of flavour, while the chilli adds a kick
instruction_lines: Put the chicory and lettuce into a serving bowl and toss through the parsley. Mix the olive oil with the vinegar, then season and use to dress the salad leaves. Toss well, so the dressing is well distributed, then sprinkle on the gorgonzola and chilli. Serve immediately. This recipe has been provided by Moje Gotowane and not been re-tested by us.
